summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MedMatch job search application. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified all 7 pages load correctly with proper navigation, data-testid attributes, and functionality. The refactored App.js (287 lines) with extracted page components works correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: MedMatch app fully tested. Backend uses FastAPI with MongoDB. Frontend uses React with shadcn/ui components. Key endpoints: /api/jobs/save (not /api/jobs/saved for POST), /api/applications/{id} (not /api/applications/{id}/status for PUT). All 7 pages have data-testid attributes. AI features use Emergent LLM Key with GPT-5.2. Email alerts use Gmail SMTP.
